text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Monday it successfully completed its tender offer for the stock of Barefoot Inc and will hold about 99 percent of the Barefoot outstanding shares.

The tender offer expired at midnight on February 21, the company said. A total of 5,021,258 Barefoot shares were tendered for cash and 9,127,011 Barefoot shares were tendered for 5,747,370 ServiceMaster shares.
ServiceMaster, a network of service copmanies, said it will proceed with a merger in which the remaining Barefoot shares will be converted to cash in the amount of $16 a share.
"ServiceMaster has accepted all tendered shares and, after consummation of the closing today, will hold approximately 99 percent of the Barefoot shares outstanding," the company said in a statement.
ServiceMaster had offered $16 or 0.62971 ServiceMaster shares for each Barefoot share tendered. Barefoot is a lawn care company with annual revenues of more than $125 million.

"We are pleased with the overwhelmingly positive response to our tender offer and excited about the opportunities created by combining Barefoot with our TruGreen-Chemlawn business," Carlos Cantu, ServiceMaster president and chief executive, said in a statement.
Shares of ServiceMaster traded off 1/8 at 25-5/8 and Barefoot shares were off 1/8 at 15-7/8.
